name: topological-sort
description: Topological sort for Directed Acyclic Graphs (DAGs). Implements both Kahn's BFS algorithm and DFS-based approaches. Detects cycles and throws a descriptive error. Used for dependency resolution, task scheduling, and build systems.
aiPromptContext: Use this block to resolve dependency order for tasks, packages, build steps, or class hierarchies represented as directed acyclic graphs.
